title: Algerian Pineapple Tagine
description: A sweet and tangy Moroccan-inspired stew made with pineapple, zesty spices, and tender chicken. Serve with crusty bread or couscous for a flavorful and exotic meal.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add chicken and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Add pineapple juice, spice blend, and salt. Stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, then cover and transfer to oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 20-25 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through.
Serve with couscous, if desired, and garnish with parsley.
